[[Five Island]] }} '''It Takes Patience, Knowledge and a Really Quick Beedrill''' is the 283rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 16th chapter of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. It is subtitled '''The Reason to Fight''' (Japanese: '''戦う訳''' ''Reason to Fight'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On [[Birth Island]], as {{adv|Giovanni}} sends out his {{p|Aggron}} to attack {{adv|Deoxys}} and claims that the power of outer space belongs to him. Deoxys manages to get out of the way with {{m|Teleport}}. Although he praises Deoxys's skills and notes how the Delta Shield will protect it from attacks while also healing it, Giovanni states he can read Deoxys like an open book. He sends out his {{TP|Giovanni|Beedrill}} and has it use {{m|Agility}} to boost its speed up to its highest. Deoxys dodges Beedrill's attacks, but the Delta Shield begins turning red, signifying that Deoxys is becoming nervous. Giovanni has his Aggron smash the Delta Shield with a {{m|Brick Break}}. He throws a [[Poké Ball]] at Deoxys, which sucks it inside and fully captures it. Giovanni picks up the Poké Ball and gloats that Deoxys is finally his. He notes how the Delta Shield is a combination of {{m|Light Screen}} and {{m|Reflect}}, so he wasn't sure that Brick Break would work so well against it. He thanks {{adv|Red}} for helping contribute to the data they managed to gather on Deoxys. He reveals that the {{i|Ruby}} and {{i|Sapphire}}, which was handed to [[Sird]], will put [[Hoenn]]'s climate all throughout [[Kanto]], which will allow Deoxys to change formes repeatedly. At the [[Rocket Warehouse]], Sird expresses delight in seeing Giovanni's successful capture of Deoxys. She tells [[Carr]] that they need to start the next phase of their plan. Carr is too distracted from the picture he found, so Sird yells at him to get his attention. Carr snaps out of it and puts the picture in his pocket while he follows Sird. On [[Five Island]], Red continues walking around. He notices {{adv|Blue}} and the {{tc|Sailor}} discussing strategies, while {{adv|Bill}} is trying to fix the [[Pokémon Center]]. He looks around more and sees {{adv|Green}} training with [[Ultima]] to help [[Blasty]] master {{m|Hydro Cannon}}. He notes how Blue and Green are fighting for their families, while he doesn't have anyone to fight for. He asks [[Pika]] if he's too scared to fight because he has no motivation. Pika sees through Red's excuse, which Red notes is because they had been through so much together. Red tells Pika that before Deoxys arrived, he could tell that it was coming. He describes it as a sharp pain inside his heart which caused his body to shake. He notes that the feeling went away when Deoxys left and guesses the feeling he had is somehow connected to Deoxys's arrival. Pika gestures to Red, which helps him realize the reason why he has to fight Deoxys: to rescue {{adv|Professor Oak}} and Green's parents from [[Team Rocket]]. In addition to this, Red wants to find out what the strange feeling he experienced was. He thanks Pika for helping him spill his hear out and sets off to go and find himself. Red decides to head to [[Seven Island]] and find [[Lorelei]], but he hears a voice in his head stating that they have already found her. Suddenly, a large spoon with Lorelei sitting inside appears in front of Red. As it tosses Lorelei on the ground, the voice states that it agrees with Red's current state of mind, as it also once went to find itself. Seeing the spoon causes Red to realize that the person in front of him is the {{type|Psychic}} [[Legendary Pokémon]] created by Team Rocket, {{adv|Mewtwo}}. ==Major events== * {{adv|Giovanni}} battles against {{adv|Deoxys}} and captures it. * {{adv|Red}} goes out on a journey to find himself. * {{adv|Mewtwo}} appears in front of Red and reveals that it saved [[Lorelei]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} (fantasy) * {{adv|Giovanni}} * {{adv|Bill}} * [[Lorelei]] * [[Ultima]]/{{tt|Kimberly|Chuang Yi}} * [[Sird]] * [[Carr]] * Green's parents (fantasy) * {{tc|Sailor}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]];
